CrowdChoreo: A Large-Scale Text-Annotated Dataset for Group Dance

Anonymous Authors

GitHub

Abstract

CrowdChoreo is the first large-scale multi-person dance dataset with text annotations, containing more than 20 hours of in-the-wild motion across 20 dance genres and groups of one to eight dancers. Built with a fully automatic data collection and filtering pipeline, it pairs world-grounded SMPL motion with frame-aligned music and clip-level text captions. To control the style and energy that music alone cannot specify, we introduce a masked modeling framework jointly conditioned on music and text. Experiments demonstrate high-quality, diverse group motion that follows text instructions and benefits from the dataset’s diversity.
